Home away from home
Mar 2026 • Couples
We ate many times at Nhan’s in 2024. At that time we thought the food was amazing and the host and staff were the friendliest we had come across anywhere in Vietnam. We returned last week to find the food as good as ever and the host and staff had the same charm friendliness and attentiveness you only find in family restaurants. You actually feel a local family has invited you home for a family dinner. It’s an easy walk from the old town or a short grab ride - go !! you won’t be disappointed.
David & Tina NZ
